🌶️ Michelin Southern Thai
Southern Thai in the Michelin Guide
intro: Southern Thai is the boldest flavor in the whole guide: chili-hot, salty, loud with turmeric and shrimp paste. It is led by Sorn, Thailand's only three-star southern kitchen, whose twenty-plus-course tasting menu is built around a southern crab curry. Below it sit Bib Gourmand favorites like The Charm Dining Gallery, whose Baba-Phuket moo hong the inspectors singled out, and Mor Mu Dong, famous for a whole mackerel deboned and restuffed with seasoned fish.

faq.q: Which southern Thai restaurant is the best in the guide?
faq.a: Sorn in Bangkok is the sole three-star southern kitchen, serving a twenty-plus-course tasting menu built around its southern crab curry. If you want southern flavor pushed to its limit, this is the one.

faq.q: Where can I eat southern Thai on a budget?
faq.a: The Bib Gourmand picks are the best value. Jaan by Khun Jim serves a Trang-style fresh shrimp nam prik and coconut sago at 99 baht a plate, while Beer Hima is known for its yellow curry with grouper.

faq.q: What southern dishes should I order?
faq.a: Try the gaeng tai pla fish-innards curry at Janhom, yellow grouper curry at Beer Hima, moo hong braised pork at The Charm Dining Gallery and One Chun, and the stuffed mackerel at Mor Mu Dong. All are hard-to-find, genuinely southern plates.

faq.q: Where should I eat southern Thai in Phuket?
faq.a: Phuket has the most southern Bib Gourmand picks in this group. One Chun is known for moo hong and crab curry with wild betel leaf and rice noodles, Mor Mu Dong for its stuffed mackerel, and Krua Kao Kuk for Hakka-Phuket fish congee from a Peranakan grandmother's recipe.

faq.q: Which restaurants should I book ahead?
faq.a: Sorn requires advance booking and fills up fast as a three-star tasting menu. Bib Gourmand spots like One Chun in Phuket and Baan Suan Lung Khai in Surat Thani get busy on weekends, so calling ahead is the safer bet.
